user.title: Sunster heater
user.description: Select a discovered Sunster heater and enter the controller PIN.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up {name}
bluetooth_confirm.description: A Sunster diesel heater was discovered by Bluetooth. Enter the controller PIN to add it.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Sunster heaters were found. Make sure the heater is powered on and within Bluetooth range, then try again.
abort.not_supported: The discovered Bluetooth device is not a supported Sunster heater.

init.title: Fuel consumption
init.description: Estimated diesel use is interpolated between these rates for heater levels 1 to 10. The defaults are the rated 0.16-0.45 L/h of the Sunster 2 kW heater. To calibrate, compare the Fuel Used sensor with a measured refill and scale both values by actual/estimated.

error.invalid_fuel_rates: The level 1 rate must not be higher than the level 10 rate.
